Delhi High Court Appoints 85 Lawyers as Senior Advocates

The Delhi High Court has designated 85 lawyers as senior advocates. Among the newly appointed senior advocates, 11 are women. This designation is a significant step in the legal profession, recognizing the expertise and standing of these legal practitioners.
